entities.name: Lushan Rebellion
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Lushan Rebellion, a transformative movement in China (712–763). Emerged from Wu Zetian becomes China's only female emperor, founding the brief Zhou dynasty and Taizong. Catalyzed Xuanzong and Battle of Talas — Tang defeated by Abbasids; papermaking spreads westward.
